note: Iowa DNR state park in the Raccoon River bottomland on the edge of West Des Moines, close to I-35 and the Highway 5 bypass; the shaded campground sits in the woods about 100 m from the river. The park is barely above normal river level and its riverside trails flood periodically. 1930s limestone-and-timber day-use lodge; the Athene pedestrian bridge crosses to Raccoon River Park. --Claude
